Introduction

zzone, formerly known as Jeewon, is a South Korean singer. She was a member of the girl groups cignature, GOOD DAY, and GOOD DAY's sub-unit Morning unit.

Jeewon made her solo debut on August 25, 2025 with the single "Devil's Jam".
